summary.content:
Today's selection covers 73 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 22 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The fanfiction community is at war with AI — and itself
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ransomware Thugs Masquerade as Interpol to Entice Small Biz
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BBC Technology, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 9 articles published in the last 24 hours
